title: Guna 369
desc: The life of Guna, a happy-go-lucky man, turns upside down when he is falsely framed for a murder and imprisoned. After his release, he sets off to hunt the real culprits and expose their crimes.

title: Antony
desc: Antony, a ruthless gangster, becomes a guardian to Ann Maria, the daughter of a local thug he killed. As they work on their relationship, a forgotten enemy returns to finish them off.

title: Seetimaarr
desc: A strong-willed coach encounters a series of sinister impediments along his journey to turn a little-known women's kabaddi team into national champions.

title: Khatarnak Ishq
desc: Arumugam, a kind-hearted and honest man, finds himself involved in a fight against corrupt politicians after he protests against the pollution of water in his village.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.
